# Mechanics evidence records (task 02)

Static mechanics evidence for the first routing profile: one record per rule the
first release depends on, each marked `observed`, `documented-only` or
`pending`. Quantitative live telemetry captures belong to task 14, in its own
directory; this directory holds the rules and their evidence status.

**Current state: the game-observation gate is UNMET.** No controlled capture has
been run for this checkout -- no Factorio installation or disposable save was
available -- so `observed` count is 0. Six rules rest on version-pinned primary
documentation; ten are `pending`. `manifest.json` reports
`mechanics_gate_unmet: true`, and `daemon/tests/test_transport_prototypes.py`
asserts it. A rule without a game observation is an unmet gate, not a passing
test.

## Files

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `records/<rule id>.json` | One mechanics rule and its evidence. |
| `manifest.json` | Generated index: statuses per rule, missing/stray records, and the gate flag. |
| `CAPTURE.md` | The repeatable controlled-game capture procedure. |

`manifest.json` is regenerated by
`daemon/tests/fixtures/routing_prototypes/generate.py`; the records are authored
by hand. `validate_observation_index` fails if the index and the records
disagree.

## Record schema (`factoribot-mechanics-observation-1`)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `record_id` | A rule id from `REQUIRED_MECHANICS_RULES`. |
| `title` | The rule, in words. |
| `profile` | Mechanics profile the record is about. |
| `setup_blueprint` | Blueprint string or repository path of the setup that was (or will be) built. `null` while nothing has been built. |
| `supplied_items` | What is fed into the setup: item, rate or count, and the source. |
| `research_state` | Named research levels in effect. `null` means unknown -- never zero. |
| `control_state` | Circuit/enable state of the setup. |
| `measurement_interval_s` | The interval a rate is measured over. |
| `expected_behavior` | What the rule says should happen, stated precisely enough to be falsified. |
| `observation_method` | How the measurement is (or would be) taken. |
| `evidence_status` | `observed`, `documented-only` or `pending`. |
| `measurement` | The recorded numbers. Only an `observed` record may carry one. |
| `environment` | `game_version`, `declared_mods`, `save`. Unknown stays `null`. |
| `references` | Reference ids of the sources actually consulted. |
| `blocking_gate` | Why the record is not `observed`. Required for `pending`. |
| `notes` | Free text, including what a wrong answer would break. |

`parse_observation` enforces the rules that matter:

- `observed` requires a setup blueprint, a measurement, a measurement interval,
  an observation method, an identified game build and mod list, and the name of
  the disposable save it came from. A record cannot become an observation by
  asserting that it is one.
- Anything not `observed` must have `measurement: null`.
- `documented-only` requires at least one reference; `pending` requires a stated
  blocking gate.

## Status of each rule

| Rule | Status | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `belt.straight.lane_capacity` | documented-only | Prototype docs give `speed x 480`; the wiki physics page independently lists 15 items/s per lane for the fast belt. |
| `belt.turn.lane_behavior` | pending | No documented throughput rule for turns. |
| `belt.side_load.lane_assignment` | pending | The wiki mentions side-loading but states no lane-assignment rule. |
| `belt.transfer.belt_to_belt` | pending | No documented handover rule. |
| `underground.pairing.range` | pending | `max_distance` has a type but no documented meaning; the wiki's "4 squares" does not say gap or separation. |
| `underground.pairing.conflict` | pending | No documented pairing rule for an intervening same-tier pair. |
| `underground.lane_mapping` | pending | No documented tunnel lane mapping. |
| `splitter.lane_split` | pending | The splitter prototype documents no tile dimensions and no lane behaviour. |
| `splitter.priority_and_filter` | pending | Runtime priority/filter behaviour is undocumented at prototype level. |
| `inserter.endpoints.pickup_drop_tiles` | documented-only | Prototype `pickup_position`/`insert_position` plus the wiki's far-lane placement rule (page states validity up to 2.0.77). |
| `inserter.rate.cycle_and_stack` | documented-only | Wiki cycle rates exist, but they are not a capacity: swing time and research are missing, so the derived rate stays null. |
| `machine.activity.assembling_machine_2` | documented-only | `crafting_speed` 0.75 from the dump; recipe arithmetic is task 01's. |
| `machine.activity.electric_furnace` | documented-only | `crafting_speed` 2.0 from the dump; a furnace has no blueprint recipe field. |
| `power.supply_assumption` | pending | Coverage/generation checks are deferred by the contract. |
| `circuit.control_state` | pending | No capture; the pilot's 2 wire entries have no recorded semantics. |
| `unsupported.entity_visibility` | documented-only | A contract and adapter rule, checked statically by the pilot coverage fixture. |

`documented-only` is enough to *state* a rule and to keep the adapter honest. It
is not enough to close the release gate: the contract requires recorded game
observations before task 03/04 advertise supported mechanics.

## Sources consulted

Version-pinned prototype documentation at `lua-api.factorio.com/2.0.76/`
(EntityPrototype, TransportBeltConnectablePrototype, UndergroundBeltPrototype,
SplitterPrototype, InserterPrototype, CraftingMachinePrototype,
AssemblingMachinePrototype), and the official wiki pages *Transport
belts/Physics*, *Underground belt* and *Inserters*, all retrieved 2026-09-08.
The wiki pages carry no version banner except *Inserters*, which states its data
is valid up to 2.0.77; that weaker versioning is exactly why the rules resting
only on wiki text are `pending`.
